SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ACMP_DB_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS ACMP_DB_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'ACMP_DB_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS ACMP_DB_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CallList_303_OBACMP' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154_') AS PDS_CALLLIST_303_OBACMP_STAGING_Stage_OB_ACMP_Members2154__sink_TableName;

SELECT dtl.* FROM ( 	SELECT sub.PREAUTH_RQST_ID, 		sub.CASE_ID, 		sub.CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID, 		TMPLT_ID = CASE WHEN tmplt_dtl.TMPLT_ID IS NULL OR tmplt_dtl.TMPLT_ID = '' THEN 'NOP' ELSE tmplt_dtl.TMPLT_ID END, 		tmplt_dtl.FLD_NM, 		VAL_TXT = CASE WHEN TRY_Convert(date,tmplt_dtl.VAL_TXT) IS NULL THEN TRY_Convert(date,tmplt_dtl.VAL_TXT,103)  ELSE TRY_Convert(date,tmplt_dtl.VAL_TXT) END, 		dmgrphc.PAT_ID, 		dmgrphc.SBSRB_ID, 		dmgrphc.PAT_FST_NM, 		dmgrphc.PAT_LST_NM, 		dmgrphc.GNDR, 		dmgrphc.DT_OF_BRTH 	FROM dbo.CASE_TMPLT_DTL tmplt_dtl 	INNER JOIN (SELECT preauth.PAT_ID, 					   preauth.CASE_ID, 					   preauth.PREAUTH_RQST_ID, 					   tmplt_dtl.CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID 				FROM dbo.PREAUTH_CASE preauth 				INNER JOIN dbo.CASE_TMPLT tmplt  				ON tmplt.CASE_ID = preauth.CASE_ID 				INNER JOIN dbo.CASE_TMPLT_DTL tmplt_dtl  				on tmplt_dtl.CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID=tmplt.CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID 				) sub 		ON tmplt_dtl.PARNT_CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID = sub.CASE_TMPLT_DTL_ID 	INNER JOIN dbo.PAT_DMGRPHC dmgrphc 		ON sub.PAT_ID = dmgrphc.PAT_ID 	WHERE tmplt_dtl.FLD_NM = 'EDC') dtl WHERE dtl.VAL_TXT >= GETDATE() + 30 ORDER BY dtl.VAL_TXT
